item.coloph: de ltar bstan srung rgyal chen grags seng srog sgrab las/ drag po dgra la rbad pa'i phrin bcol myur byed srog len 'di/ dpal gshen bstan rnam rgyal kun grags gling gi mkhan chen 'dul (zla) ba rgyal mtshan gyis gsung gi (gis) bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra thos chung snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyi (gyis) yi ger btab te phul//
